defectFoundAndFixed.title: Opening a book destroyed its stored p:<part>:<frac> position
defectFoundAndFixed.mechanism: The load effect restores the position asynchronously (window.api.readBook → loadEpub/loadPdf → partRef/localFracRef). Its cleanup wrote the position back unconditionally. If the effect was torn down before that async load resolved, the cleanup persisted the INITIAL refs — part 0, fraction 0 — because `const [part] = useState(0)` and `localFracRef = useRef(0)`. `percent` survived intact, because `curGlobalRef` is seeded from `item.progress.percent`, which is exactly why the damage was invisible: the reader reopened at the right percentage via its coarse fallback mapping while the precise locator was gone.
defectFoundAndFixed.whyItFiredEveryTime: React.StrictMode tears the first mount down on every mount in development. In a production build it needs a real early close (a large EPUB closed before it finishes loading).
defectFoundAndFixed.observedLive: before opening: p:12:0.6207 — immediately after opening: p:0:0.0000, percent unchanged at 0.0311
defectFoundAndFixed.fix: a positionRestoredRef guard: the cleanup returns without writing until the stored position has actually been restored into the refs, and the flag resets at the top of the effect so a book change cannot persist the previous book's part
defectFoundAndFixed.afterFixObservedLive: reopening the same book wrote p:12:0.0000 — the part is preserved
defectFoundAndFixed.regressionTest: src/renderer/__tests__/novelReaderProgressGuard.test.ts — mounts the reader with readBook left pending, unmounts, and asserts setProgress was not called. Verified to FAIL on the unguarded code (one call, with p:0:0.0000) and pass with the guard.

secondaryObservation.what: The restored within-part fraction is snapped by the paged layout: 0.6207 came back as 0.0000.
secondaryObservation.mechanism: applyLocal computes the page as round(lf * (pages - 1)) and then rewrites localFracRef as page / (pages - 1), which is exactly 0 when the part occupies a single page at the current font and viewport.
secondaryObservation.classification: NOT recorded as a defect — a single-page part genuinely has no sub-position, so 0.0000 is the only representable value. Recorded because it is the reason a reopened position can shift slightly (percent 0.0311 → 0.0282 here), and because a future session comparing stored fractions should not read it as corruption.

toolingGapFound.what: Two renderer component tests have never run.
toolingGapFound.detail: vitest.config.ts includes only src/renderer/__tests__/**/*.test.ts, but src/renderer/__tests__/ contains externalPlayerPanel.test.tsx and mediaTrackingSourcesHistory.test.tsx. Both are silently skipped — `vitest run <path>` on a .tsx file there reports 'No test files found'.
toolingGapFound.notFixedHere: the include glob lives in root config, which CLAUDE.md places out of scope for this work; the new regression test is therefore written with createElement in a .test.ts file
toolingGapFound.consequence: any renderer component test added as .test.tsx in that directory is dead on arrival
